commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@6be022066fd2

Adapted to change of ROCDL "wave per eu" attributes type from int to string in LLVM commit
4d5db577f969 [mlir][ROCDL][AMDGPU] Support string waves_per_eu for min,max occupancy range (#225663)

The TOSA compliance table has grown beyond what MSVC can support on the stack.
Apparently, the function size / stack size has been an issue before, see e.g.:
9e69e851a1f8 [NFC][mlir][tosa] Use optnone for compliance initialization under ASan (#229292)
1e9bc138d8f3 [mlir][Tosa] Optimize compliance initialization for size to improve build time (NFC) (#222791)
According to the recommendation from https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/232065#issuecomment-6211169605
the stack limit of compiler tools on MSVC is increased to 10MB.

Claude Code has been used to find the LLVM commits related to the issued and adapt the IREE side code. The changes have been reviewed manually.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: pre-commit

Adapted to change of ROCDL "wave per eu" attributes type from int to string in LLVM commit
4d5db577f969 [mlir][ROCDL][AMDGPU] Support string waves_per_eu for min,max occupancy range (#225663)

The TOSA compliance table has grown beyond what MSVC can support on the stack.
Apparently, the function size / stack size has been an issue before, see e.g.:
9e69e851a1f8 [NFC][mlir][tosa] Use optnone for compliance initialization under ASan (#229292)
1e9bc138d8f3 [mlir][Tosa] Optimize compliance initialization for size to improve build time (NFC) (#222791)
According to the recommendation from https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/232065#issuecomment-6211169605
the stack limit of compiler tools on MSVC is increased to 10MB.

Claude Code has been used to find the LLVM commits related to the issued and adapt the IREE side code. The changes have been reviewed manually.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: Test Android / android_arm64
